subject: Re: [Redwood] IAM evidence & SOC 2 status — next steps
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-05-09T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: [Redwood] IAM evidence & SOC 2 status — next steps

Hi Liam / Alice / team,

Thanks for the call earlier — good to meet everyone. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single place to track evidence requests and responsibilities.

Call summary (30 min):
- Use case: MedBranch wants to embed clinical summarization and pre-triage prompts into clinician workflows.
- Compliance: HIPAA scope is required; SOC 2 Type II preferred; GDPR not primary but DPA requested.
- IAM: SSO required (SAML 2.0), SCIM provisioning desired, RBAC with fine-grained roles, audit logs and admin controls for separation of duties.

Immediate asks from your side:
1) Confirm whether your legal team requires a signed BAA prior to POC.
2) Confirm preferred IdP (Okta / Azure AD / other).
3) Please complete the attached vendor security questionnaire (we saw a few items on the call we can pre-fill).

What we can provide (initial):
- Redwood SOC 2 summary (attached) and access to full Type II report under NDA.
- SAML metadata endpoint and SCIM v2 support; we support role mapping and can share a canonical RBAC table.
- Audit logs: per-token and admin action logs; default retention 90 days with archive options.

Proposed timeline:
- By EOD tomorrow (May 10): you send the completed VSAQ and confirm IdP.
- By May 12: Redwood to drop an IAM evidence bundle (SAML metadata, SCIM docs, RBAC mapping, audit retention notes).
- Week of May 17: security review call for any follow-ups.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (summary), requested-iam-checklist.csv (we'll use this to track artifacts).

If this looks right I will loop in Monica (security solutions) and Rishi (security engineering) to assemble the evidence pack.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (application/pdf), requested-iam-checklist.csv (text/csv)

Naomi — thanks for the summary and the PDF. A few clarifications from MedBranch side:

1) BAA / HIPAA: Yes, we require a BAA signed before we move PHI into any environment. Please send standard BAA / DPA templates; we can start legal review in parallel.
2) SOC 2: We need a current SOC 2 Type II report. If there's redacted access under NDA that works — please share next steps to access it.
3) IdP: Primary is Okta; we do have a small Azure AD tenant for contractors.
4) IAM / provisioning: SCIM preferred for provisioning; SAML required for SSO. We need example SAML metadata and sample SCIM mappings.
5) RBAC: We will provide role use-cases; please confirm what built-in roles Redwood exposes and whether custom roles are supported.
6) Audit logs: We need admin action audit trails (who promoted user to admin, role changes) and token-level access logs; retention target initially 1 year, but open to archive options.

Attached: MedBranch_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx (we completed the first pass).

Next step: can you have your security engineer reach out to mine (alice.wright@medbranch.com) to coordinate the evidence bundle? We can designate a dropbox / Drive folder for artifacts.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Information Security | MedBranch Health
liam.oconnor@medbranch.com
Attachments: MedBranch_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

Thanks Naomi — looping in our security engineering notes and ETA. Short answers and what we'll upload to the Drive folder by EOD May 12:

1) SOC 2: We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report under NDA. Standard flow: sign NDA/DocuSign (link below) and we will grant read-only access to the report in a time-limited S3 bucket.
   - DocuSign NDA link: https://www.docusign.com/link/mb-nda-4521

2) BAA / HIPAA: Redwood has a standard BAA template. Legal prefers to exchange via DocuSign but I can upload the template to the Drive folder now for your legal team to review.

3) SSO / SAML: We provide a SAML metadata endpoint (entityID + metadata XML), and a simple SP configuration guide for Okta. Attached: sso-implementation-diagram.png (shows redirect flow and attribute mappings). SCIM: We support SCIM v2 with user and group provisioning and can provide example mapping JSON.

4) RBAC: Built-in roles: org-admin, org-auditor, app-admin, developer, viewer. Custom role support: yes (team-level permissions). We will include a canonical RBAC mapping table with recommended mappings for MedBranch roles.

5) Audit logs: Admin action logs and token/session logs are available. Default retention 90 days in hot storage; we can configure archive to S3 for 1 year or longer on request (we'll note costs in the bundle). We will attach a sample admin audit export (CSV) showing role changes and timestamps.

6) Data residency & HIPAA controls: Redwood hosted US regions; we will confirm region-by-region storage and provide a short note on encryption at rest (AES-256) and key management (KMS/HSM integration).

Deliverables (to Drive by EOD May 12):
- Redacted SOC 2 Type II (NDA gated)
- BAA template and DPA note
- SAML metadata & Okta SP guide
- SCIM v2 sample mapping (JSON)
- RBAC canonical mapping table (CSV)
- Sample admin audit export (CSV)
- One-page note on retention and archive pricing

Question for MedBranch: for provisioning do you want group-based provisioning (recommended) or user-only? Also confirm whether contractors should be in the same Okta org or a separate tenant.

I will upload attachments to the Drive folder and ping once complete.

-Rishi Malhotra
Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
